# Description

**MachineHole** is a modpack focused on large-scale and realistic industrialization: from simple steam engines to complex aircraft from the _Valkyrien Skies_ mod series. Building resource chains and creating platforms will take weeks, and players will need to progress from water wheels and the complicated content of regular _Create_, all the way to custom-built rockets and nuclear power.

_The modpack is designed for multiplayer survival, but it will also work well in a single-player world, although progression will require much more time._

## KubeJS and add-ons

The modpack contains custom add-ons to create artificial compatibility, for example: 

Crash fixes between _Valkyrien Skies_ and Power Grid mods. It also features a custom oxygen system that interacts with _Create_ tanks, adds a custom "Oxygen Generator", modifies blocks from the _Cosmic Horizon_ mod, and reworks various other minor aspects of the modpack, such as disabling ender pearls and elytra, as well as overall balance changes.
